title: So you want to use OpenRouter?
summary: So you want to use OpenRouter? One of OpenRouter's selling points is that it "handles fallbacks automatically and picks the most cost-effective option for each request", so you can call a single API endpoint for a model and get routed to the best available backend provider. Moham
reason: An explanatory blog post about how to use OpenRouter (a commercial API routing service).
